name: Generations
source:
You've been called upon to Save The Galaxy, Captain! And Fullfill Your Desires while you're at it!

In this thrilling visual novel adventure, you are the esteemed captain of a generation starship, entrusted with a vital mission to save the galaxy from a devastating infertility virus. But it's not just about battles, interstellar diplomacy, and psuedoscience! Your ship's crew is a diverse ensemble of captivating characters, each with their own desires, secrets, and romantic potential.

As you navigate the treacherous depths of space, your choices and interactions will shape the course of the galaxy's fate as well as the relationships you build. Engage in sizzling romances, build deep connections, and even breed with your crew members in hopes of counteracting the virus' impact. Will you find true love while on your journey? Can you inspire hope and ignite passions amidst the stars?

Explore stunning science fiction visuals, uncover tantalizing mysteries, and engage in captivating dialogue that blurs the line between duty and desire. Make crucial decisions that affect not only your own relationships but also the survival of entire civilizations. The fate of love and life itself rests in your hands.

Are you ready to become the hero of a breathtaking tale that combines heart-pounding romance, intense action, and a race against time to save the galaxy?

Will you answer the hail, captain?

[From [url=https://blindnagastudios.itch.io/generations]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你被要求拯救银河系，船长！并满足你的愿望！

在这场激动人心的视觉小说冒险中，你是一代星际飞船受人尊敬的船长，肩负着拯救银河系免受毁灭性不孕病毒侵害的重要使命。但这不仅仅是战斗、星际外交和伪科学！你的船员是一群多元化的迷人角色，每个人都有自己的欲望、秘密和浪漫潜力。

当你在危险的太空深处航行时，你的选择和互动将决定银河系的命运以及你建立的关系的进程。参与火热的浪漫，建立深厚的联系，甚至与你的船员繁殖，以期抵消病毒的影响。你会在旅途中找到真爱吗？你能在群星之中激发希望、点燃激情吗？

探索令人惊叹的科幻视觉效果，揭开诱人的谜团，并参与模糊责任与欲望之间界限的迷人对话。做出的重要决定不仅会影响你们自己的关系，还会影响整个文明的生存。爱情和生命本身的命运掌握在你的手中。

你准备好成为这个惊心动魄的故事的英雄了吗？这个故事结合了令人心潮澎湃的浪漫、激烈的动作以及与时间赛跑来拯救银河系的一切？

你会回应冰雹吗，船长？
